hardware: CPU; standard library; zero training API calls

experiment.initialization: all-zero fresh Selector; no historical Mercy House weights

intended_target.work: The Mentalist S1E8: The Thin Red Line
intended_target.mechanism: Separate the intended victim from the other casualty.

foreknowledge.mechanism: Apparent foreknowledge is not proof that the speaker committed a killing; investigate a family-connected alternative.

trusted_relative.mechanism: Test a trusted relative and a plausible accusation against independent observation.

experiment.reward: Binary terminal exercise reward: requested supported proposition with acquired provenance and no false/unsupported findings. Whole-case Town coverage score is recorded separately.
experiment.proposer: Authored rules read only acquired public descriptions and comparisons; not learned reading or source-episode understanding.
experiment.npc_condition: cooperative deterministic fixture with normal disclosure gates; zero API calls
experiment.split: No canonical Mercy House snapshot or elite trajectory in new training; reused FamilyTown causal templates and seed-heldout checkpoints, not unseen-template evaluation.
limitations: Original mechanism-inspired exercises, not exact source episodes or copied scripts.
Prior legal acquisitions are prepared at checkpoints.
No emotional state, hatred or ego is measured.
False accusations and unsupported source claims receive no exercise success; no bonuses for dialogue count.
